name: Home Screen Sections Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs and saves hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home-section drafts using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries. It does not yet render the saved sections.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Sections Manager design and Abyss customization UI for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Restores the exact tab styling used by the other two plugins, replaces bordered type cards with native Jellyfin radio controls and proper description spacing, keeps the type picker open after selection, advances reliably to every type-specific picker, and uses the standard Jellyfin Dashboard save notification. Test only; it does not yet render actual home-screen sections.
